title: Launcher 0.8.4: one account, a new welcome
summary: A new welcome screen, one login for the launcher and game, and a redesigned Account tab for your profile, presence and characters.
body:
## One account for Esteria

Launcher 0.8.4 brings account creation, sign-in and your player profile together. Use the same game account name and password in the launcher and World of Warcraft: Esteria.

### A new welcome

The launcher opens with a new Esteria welcome screen when you are signed out. Sign in with an existing game account, or choose **Create account** to register with an account name, password and email address. Creating an account also signs you into the launcher, ready to set up your client and start exploring.

### Your Account tab

**Account** replaces the Game Account tab and the old Profile and presence popup. Click the account icon or your name in the friends panel to open it.

- Edit your display name, presence, status message, bio and favorite character.
- Change your profile picture and header, with a preview at the top of the page.
- Browse your characters, use character services, and restore eligible deleted characters.
- Manage your shared password and game account email.

Your display name can still be different from your game account name. Changing your shared password signs you out so you can sign back in with the new one. Saved sessions are checked when the launcher starts; an expired session returns you to sign-in.

### Keep your existing profile

Already linked a launcher profile to your game account? Sign in with your **game account credentials** to keep using that profile, including its friends, chats and pictures.

If you previously used a separate, unlinked launcher profile, expand **Already have a separate launcher profile?** and verify its previous name and password once. This preserves your profile while moving you to your game credentials. If you only have a launcher account, you can create its game account through the same screen.

### Client repair fix

This release also includes the recent fix for updates failing on empty client files, such as equipment.csv. The launcher now creates missing empty files before checking their hashes.

### Get the update

Restart the launcher or click **Check for updates** in the top bar, then install version **0.8.4**. Once updated, sign in with your game account and open **Account** to make your profile your own.
